entities.summary: Shota Voskanyan (b. 1960-06-26, Yerevan) was a musician or composer of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Yerevan and Armenia. Known in the fields of armenia, painters & sculptors, asia.
